name: webspot.com

sources.title: webspot.com — parked domain page ('This domain may be for sale')

requirements: None — the domain is parked and offers no directory, listing, or submission functionality
workflow: Do not plan a submission. As of 2026-09-25 the domain serves only a generic parked page ('Find information, resources and relevant links for webspot.com. This domain may be for sale.') with no product, signup, or submit surface
watchFor: Parked-domain pages can host ads/malvertising-style links — do not follow sponsored links on the page
If a tool claims it can 'submit to webspot.com', that claim is stale or fabricated
unknowns: Whether a real 'Webspot' directory ever existed at this domain or the catalog entry refers to a different site (e.g., webspot on a different TLD)
